map.模型显存估算是做什么的？: What does Model VRAM Estimator do?
map.如何使用模型显存估算？: How do I use Model VRAM Estimator?
map.模型显存估算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Model VRAM Estimator best for?
map.按参数量与字节数估算权重显存。: Estimate weight VRAM from parameter count and bytes.
map.权重显存 ≈ 参数量 × 每参数字节数；总显存 ≈ 权重 + 激活/1000: Weight VRAM ~ parameters x bytes per param; total VRAM ~ weights + activation/1000
map.推理显存主要由权重决定：FP16 为 2 字节、INT8 为 1 字节、FP32: Inference VRAM is mainly determined by weights: FP16 is 2 bytes, INT8 is 1 byte, FP32 is 4 bytes. Training also adds gradients and Adam states (one and two extra copies of weights respectively), plus activation values that grow with batch and sequence length, often several times the weights themselves.
map.显存 ≈ 参数(十亿)×字节 + 激活开销: VRAM ~ params (billions) x bytes + activation overhead
map.训练还需优化器状态（通常 2–4 倍权重）。: Training also needs optimizer states (usually 2-4x the weights).
map.权重显存≈参数量×每参数字节数(FP16=2, INT8=1, FP32=4)。: Weight VRAM ~ parameters x bytes per param (FP16=2, INT8=1, FP32=4).
map.推理显存还需加激活/KV 缓存，训练另需梯度与优化器状态(常数倍于权重)。: Inference VRAM also needs activation/KV cache; training additionally needs gradients and optimizer states (constant multiples of weights).
map.估算用于硬件选型、batch 设定与显存溢出预警。: The estimate is used for hardware selection, batch setting and VRAM-overflow warning.
map.7B 参数 FP16：权重≈7e9×2=14GB；加 KV 缓存与激活后推理约: 7B params FP16: weights ~ 7e9 x 2 = 14GB; with KV cache and activation, inference is about 16-18GB, runnable on a 24GB GPU; if training, add gradients + optimizer (~ 3-4x weights).
map.为什么训练显存远大于推理？: Why is training VRAM much larger than inference?
map.训练需保留前向激活供反向、存梯度(同尺寸)与优化器状态(Adam 约 2 倍权重: Training must keep forward activations for backprop, store gradients (same size) and optimizer states (Adam about 2x weights), often bringing total VRAM to 3-4x the weights; inference only needs weights + a little activation.
map.量化降权重字节数、用梯度检查点换计算省激活、降 batch、或模型并行/张量并行: Quantize to reduce weight bytes, use gradient checkpointing to trade compute for activation savings, reduce batch, or use model/tensor parallel sharding; if necessary, use larger VRAM or distribution.
